description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transfer Case Gasket Kit. It comes with the Gaskets for both the Front & Center Cases.
Plus you get the Qty 2 Guide Pins for Case alignment.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Gasket, Front Case
Qty 1 – Gasket, Center Case
Qty 2 – Guide Pins
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
